reason: Rules for the Trellis bookkeeping validator and the preflight that owns the journal checks. Both diagnostics this task is built on -- journal_content_missing and planning_recovery_commit_non_linear -- come from that surface, and the pack-local half of the fix lands there.

Installer and pack-metadata rules. The upstream-versus-pack-local split rests on .trellis/scripts having zero manifest.json entries, so what manifest ownership actually means has to be right before the fix is placed.

Thinking guides, including the false-positive budget. R1 adds a check to a blocking gate, and a collision rule that misfires on an ordinary single-branch session costs more than the collision it prevents.
